text:
Rhea Kapoor: PraxisModels reached out — they want us to onboard praxis-13b-open to the marketplace and enable an SI integration with VectorScale + an AetherCompute edge offering. Core asks: can we host EU-only instances, and are we allowed to distribute quantized derivatives to partners?

Diego Alvarez: For Marketplace I need model-card, license text (SPDX), checksum, and an initial perf summary. Also confirm whether Praxis permits commercial redistribution of derived artifacts.

Nina Park: From SI perspective VectorScale needs either q4_0 artifacts or permission to run in-house quantization. They also want an offline deploy option for air-gapped customers.

Samir Joshi: Ops note: AetherCompute requires OCI bundles signed and a manifest with provenance.json. KMS integration for Private deployments will need customer-managed keys; that adds provisioning time.

legal-bot: Quick scan: license appears to be "MIT-style with attribution" but model-card references third-party CC-licensed data. Recommend explicit clause: "Derived Artifacts Redistribution" and a warranty carveout re: third-party data. Uploading precedent addendum links.

Rhea Kapoor: Perfect. Proposed launch flow: 1) ingest + QA (Eng-Platform, 3 days), 2) quant/eval (Eng-ML, 2-4 days), 3) SI validation with VectorScale (5 days), 4) embargo 7 days, then co-announcement. Can we hit that in 3 weeks?

Diego Alvarez: Tight but possible if Praxis supplies q4 artifacts and logos within 48 hours. If not, Eng-ML conversion will cost an extra 2 days and we need distribution rights in contract.

Nina Park: VectorScale wants an integration test harness and a reproducible perf report. I'll document required endpoints and a smoke test.

Samir Joshi: Also flag: some enterprise customers asked Praxis to sign a geofencing SLA. Legal will need to include Geoblocking Addendum + data residency language. That can add negotiation time.

Rhea Kapoor: Responsibility matrix draft: Partnerships = partner comms + announcement; Eng-Platform = ingest, SKU pages; Eng-ML = quant + perf; SI = validation; Ops = OCI + KMS; Legal = license addendum + geofencing.

legal-bot: Action: Recommend template "Derived Artifacts & Geofencing Addendum v3". Marcus (Legal) to draft and send to Praxis counsel by EOD tomorrow.

Diego Alvarez: Action: I'll produce Marketplace ingest checklist and preliminary SKU tiers (hosted / dedicated / private-eu-only). Posting draft link shortly.

Nina Park: Action: I'll share VectorScale test harness and expected validation timeline. If Praxis can't share quant artifacts, note in the harness that Eng-ML conversion may be required.

Samir Joshi: Action: I'll prepare OCI signing instructions and KMS integration notes for Private deployments. ETA 48 hours.

Rhea Kapoor: Meeting reconvene in 24h to confirm license status and artifact availability. If Praxis can't sign redistribution rights, decision point: host-only + limited SI using API vs delay for full offline distribution.

Diego Alvarez: ack :thumbsup:

Nina Park: ack, will loop VectorScale engineers in after license clarity.

Samir Joshi: ack, will prep ops checklist.

Rhea Kapoor: Thanks team — keeping this lean so we don't miss partner window. Flag blockers here immediately.
